antivirus.title: Antivirus Software & Clash Mini Compatibility
antivirus.whyTitle: Why do antivirus tools clean up Clash Mini?
antivirus.why: Clash Mini stays resident in the system tray and runs a dedicated proxy core subprocess (mini-mihomo.exe) to route traffic; after you close the main window into lightweight mode, the WebView2 UI window is destroyed to save memory while only the tray and background processes remain active. That pattern — “no visible main window yet a background proxy subprocess keeps running” — can be misclassified by heuristic scanners or “clean-up / speed-up” sweeps in security tools like 360 as a leftover process, terminating the app or core and making the tray icon vanish and your network drop. This is a false positive — Clash Mini is open source, fully auditable, and has no hidden behavior.
antivirus.benefitTitle: What do I gain by adding Clash Mini to the trust list?
antivirus.consequence:
If you run 360 without adding Clash Mini to the trust zone, you may see:
· The tray icon vanish after 360's “clean-up” sweeps (most visible in lightweight mode);
· The tray icon or mini-mihomo.exe get terminated by mistake in lightweight mode — you must reopen Clash Mini manually.
All of this is caused by 360 interception; simply reopening Clash Mini restores everything. The app itself is not broken.
antivirus.howTitle: How to add Clash Mini to 360's Trust Zone
antivirus.how: Open 360 Safety Guard → “Trojan Firewall / Trust & Protection” → “Trust Zone” → add Clash Mini's install directory (default: C:\Program Files\Clash Mini\), or add clash-mini.exe and mini-mihomo.exe inside it. Entry names vary slightly across 360 versions; search for “Trust Zone” or “whitelist” in its settings.
antivirus.brief: Its “clean-up” may sweep away Clash Mini's background tray process (especially in lightweight mode). Adding the install folder (default C:\Program Files\Clash Mini\, or clash-mini.exe and mini-mihomo.exe inside it) to the Trust Zone prevents this completely; skipping it doesn't affect normal proxying — just reopen Clash Mini if the icon disappears.
